daily_name_contains_note: Case-insensitive substrings of the calendar event or Meetily meeting name; matching meetings get short notes (daily_notes_prompt.md) and a tasks-only roll-up on daily_model.
partner_summary_min_english_note: Meetings (not dailies) with at least this share of English speech get summary-en.txt (partner_summary_prompt.md, plain-text WeChat message) sent to Telegram for copying.
share_dir_note: One PDF per meeting (notes + Chinese-chatter summary + cleaned transcript), named after the meeting folder (share.py).
